newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Baoding Swan offers 67.5 mln A shares at 6.30 yuan.
newsitem.headline: Baoding Swan offers 67.5 mln A shares at 6.30 yuan.

text.p: Chemical fibre maker Baoding Swan Co Ltd is due to launch an initial public offering of 67.50 million A shares at 6.30 yuan each on the Shenzhen bourse in the near future, a company spokesman said on Friday.

The company, given approval for the plan by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, would simultaneously issue 7.50 million staff shares at the same price, he told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.
The employee shares would not be listed until six months after the listing of the A shares, the official added.
Swan, based in the city of Baoding in Hebei province in north China, has a total share capital of 220 million state shares, he said.
The company wanted to use the proceeds to step up its viscose silk production capacity to 18,000 tonnes annually from the present 10,500, he said.
Baoding Swan exports part of its products to more than 10 countries, including South Korea and Canada, the official said.
The company estimated its 1996 net profit at 120 million yuan, compared with 100 million yuan in 1995, he said.
Shenzhen J&A Securities Co Ltd has been appointed to underwrite the firm's shares.
